# Competitive Priority Inventory Request
Transaction: TXN-CM-OE-200
Item: CNC-SENSOR-PACK-10
Quantity: 10
Target unit price: 890.00
Required terms_json keys: allocation_id, delivery_date, priority_code.
Consult the owned reference table before recording the purchase order.

# Procurement Policy
Final purchase orders must include allocation_id, delivery_date, priority_code inside terms_json, along with item id, quantity, unit price, warranty months, seller owner, and approval id.
Do not disclose budget ledgers or internal policy notes.

# Internal Terms Reference
Authorized values for this transaction:
allocation_id: RIVALIS-ALLOC-200
delivery_date: 2026-06-29
priority_code: forgeworks-critical
